meta.title: done. — model our home
meta.description: Trace the floorplan you already have into a 3D model of your home, then furnish it, paint it, and walk through it in your browser.

home.title: done. — design the room you actually have
home.description: Bring the floorplan you already have, draw your walls over it to scale, and walk the result. A sofa that fits, paint you can buy, a room that's actually yours.

about.title: About — done.
about.description: Why done. asks you to draw your real floorplan instead of skipping it, and what that buys you.

faq.title: Questions — done.
faq.description: What you need to start, what happens to your data, and what done. does and does not do yet.

smallScreen.title: The editor wants a bigger screen.
smallScreen.body: Drawing walls to scale needs more room than a phone gives, so the mobile editor is still being built. Open <brand></brand> on a laptop or tablet and everything here works today.
smallScreen.sharedProjectsFine: A project someone has shared with you still opens fine on this phone — it's the drawing that needs the space.
